description: Werkingsgebied - Herstructureringsgebied windturbines binnen de MRA is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Deze werkingsgebied maakt onderdeel uit van Omgevingsverordening NH2020, vastgesteld op 16-11-2020 (besluitnr.: 1477251/1478383). Het plan is te raadplegen op ruimtelijkeplannen.nl via deze link: Meer informatie over deze werkingsgebied is te lezen in artikel(en): 6.27. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are ruimtegebruik, ruimtelijke-ordening. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2024-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
